heading: Performance accountability system
lead: Programs and activities authorized in this subchapter are subject to the performance accountability provisions described in section 3141 of this title.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective on the first day of the first full program year after July 22, 2014 (July 1, 2015), see section 506 of Pub. L. 113–128, set out as a note under section 3101 of this title.
